scope: manual diagnostic, deliberately selected and previously exposed source family; no blind score

cases.basis: mit + material/mell favors a dative form; ordinary words and known German grammar do most work. Historical case/spelling variation prevents a proof of uniqueness.
leg sy in ... topph describes placement into a pot, favoring accusative under the expected locative/directional contrast. Source-specific nonstandard usage or a location construal could retain einem.
stozz in In ... Morser can describe pounding in a mortar or placing/pushing into one; the following mixture instruction does not force the case. Slight preference for einem is not a decision.

The complete roast-fowl context supports the referent, not one versus two r in the expansion. The more ordinary/common spelling preference is not a contextual discriminator. Other licensed strings remain in the packet.
huner prue fits broth made from fowl; this does not independently exclude hunerr as an editorial/historical spelling. D and E get the same preference despite different contexts.

slach die ... ein sib supports a through/sieve construction, but both strings can be the same lexical preposition in variant spelling. Aggregate 93:1 source counts were already seen; choosing durich cannot count as context evidence.

Known previously inspected sequitur countercase: desired ui precedes t, whereas every legal local output keeps seqt as its prefix. Context cannot recover an output outside the fixed relation. Initial and terminal unknown spans stay unknown.
